items.title: Show HN: Pi pod – Run your pi coding agent in sandboxes on your own server
items.excerpt: pi pod runs sessions of the pi coding agent in isolated sandboxes ("pods") on a server you run, in composable environments. ---- Since moving my company towards AI-native work, I have been really frustrated by the state of "agentic engineering" environments. Products by the labs (claude code, codex) lock you into a single provider for your tokens. Agnostic solutions (factory, devin, arguably cursor) make you pay per-token costs. None of these products allow you to fully customize the harness, and of course they all run on someone else's infrastructure. I've been an early and fervent user of pi
items.summary: Pi pod runs AI coding agent sessions in isolated sandboxes on user-operated servers with customizable environments, avoiding single-provider lock-in and per-token costs.
items.usefulness: Could enable building Python tools that execute generated code safely if you operate your own infrastructure and want to avoid vendor dependency.
items.to_verify: Whether pi pod actually supports arbitrary Python tool customization and what sandbox isolation guarantees it provides against model-generated malicious code.
